limitations: The exemption covers ordinary share sales only. An ETF sleeve is taxed regardless of size, so a book holding the global sleeve gets less relief than this table shows.
Each review is assumed to fall in a distinct calendar month and to be the client's only share sale that month. A client selling elsewhere in the same month loses the exemption.
The threshold is a legal parameter that changes; it is read from BrazilianTaxModel, not hard-coded here.
Execution cost rises with cadence and is charged; the intra-year path is otherwise unchanged.
